subject: Video captions
body:
Student-channel filming checklist

Keep contact details, name badges and reception paperwork out of frame. A shallow blur isn't a reliable privacy plan. Ask before posting somebody's face, and give them a direct route to request a change.

Captions need an actual description as well as the joke. Check teaching terms against the spoken words; automatic output can be entertaining without being correct.

If a clip is staged, say so in the post. Viewers shouldn't have to find a comment several screens down to learn that. Leave space behind the text so it stays readable over pale walls. Mira
title: Video captions
